user.title: Select EPT Tech LPG Level Sensor
user.description: Select the EPT Tech LPG Level Sensor you want to set up, or choose to enter the MAC address manually.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your EPT Tech LPG Level Sensor (e.g. E8:FA:8C:8A:2F:10).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered EPT Tech LPG Level Sensor
